run_healthfact_main: run the HealthFact module to generate k-shot data splits for multiple random seeds
create_healthfact_dataset: create a HealthFact classification dataset instance with false, mixture, true, and unproven labels
load_healthfact_hf_dataset: load the health_fact dataset from HuggingFace using the load_dataset method
map_healthfact_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of cleaned claim and label tuples
review_healthfact_class: review the HealthFact class and its label mapping for health claim classification
